title: Certified exact maximum Sidon set sizes f(n) in Z_n for n = 2..110 (modular Golomb ruler table re-certification)
problem: f(n) = max{|A| : A subset of Z_n with all sums a+b (doubles included) distinct} = OEIS A260999; inverse a(k)=min{n: f(n)>=k} = A004136. Determine f(n) exactly at machine-reachable sizes with deterministic exhaustive search + completeness argument + independent checker.
hypothesis: Our independent solver reproduces the published exact values on [2,110] and extends the documented-certified prefix (peer-reviewed to n=84) to n=110; any mismatch would be a published-table error.
baseline: OEIS A260999: values n<=84 credited to Haanpaa-Huima-Ostergard 'Sets in Z_n with Distinct Sums of Pairs', Discrete Appl. Math. 138 (2004) 99-106; n=85..295 witnesses+values contributed by F. Cariboni 2017-18 with undocumented proof status. Related: Buratti & Stinson arXiv:2007.01908 (MGR existence k<=11); Gordon arXiv:2408.16721.
proposed_improvement: Rerunnable deterministic DFS (translation-only symmetry => trivially complete argument), counting-bound level protocol, two cross-checked implementations, definition-based independent checker with corruption battery, plus audit of all published witness sets for n<=110.

experimental_evidence.what: Exact f(n) certified for all n in [2,110]; 0 timeouts; hardest proof n=105 k=10 UNSAT (244,412,475 nodes, ~91 s); matches OEIS b-file everywhere (0 mismatches); 109/109 Cariboni witnesses valid under strict checker; recomputed inverse a(2..10)=3,7,13,21,31,48,57,73,91 equals A004136.
experimental_evidence.how_to_reproduce: bash research/experiments/S1/run.sh  (or stepwise: python research/experiments/S1/run.py solve --lo 2 --hi 90 --tag chunkA --deadline-ms 300000 ; ... verify --hi 110 --results main_chunkA.json main_chunkB.json main_chunkC.json)
experimental_evidence.result: outputs/verification_upto_110.json verdict CLEAN; outputs/summary_n2_110.csv holds 109 certified rows with witnesses

experimental_evidence.what: Adversarial testing of pipeline: checker corruption battery (10 cases incl. weak-vs-strict trap), naive itertools ground truth vs solvers on n=2..14, python-vs-node agreement on n=2..30, determinism rerun (identical node counts/witnesses for n=92,105).

adversarial_attacks: checker corruption battery incl. deliberately broken objects and an A260998-convention object that must FAIL strict checking
third brute-force implementation (no symmetry assumptions) as ground truth at small n
audit of third-party published witness sets (all passed)
novelty_notes: Family is well tabulated: peer-reviewed exact values to n=84 (Haanpaa et al. 2004), OEIS extension to n=295 by Cariboni (witnesses only). No new exact value within our reach: extending f(n) past n~111 needs k=11 UNSAT proofs beyond budget; extending A004136 past k=18 is blocked by open projective-plane-of-order-18 existence. Contribution is honest saturation/re-certification with public completeness arguments, positioned per mission option (c). Audit: research/literature/S1-novelty.md (accessed 2026-08-26).
next_action: Push certified prefix past n=110 (first place a genuinely new exact value can appear): add unit-multiplication canonicalization / canonical augmentation or CDCL SAT encoding for k=11 UNSAT proofs at n=111..119.
